quote.description: The quoted words exactly as the content carries them. Elisions are written … or […] and the validator checks each surviving fragment against `context` in order.

source.description: The Source the quotation is attributed to

pages.description: The locator, if one was actually seen

items.description: Qualified entity id, e.g. 1914:marne or person:joffre-joseph

usedIn.description: Entity ids whose text carries this quotation — a document, a beat, a card

url.description: What was fetched — required when `how` is "fetch"

copy.description: Which copy was opened — required when `how` is "read". Name it precisely enough that somebody else could find the same one: an edition and a library, an archive shelfmark.

checkedBy.description: Who or what did it — a person, or an agent and model

context.description: The retrieved text around the quotation, verbatim and long enough that a reviewer can see the quotation in place. This is the receipt; the rest is metadata about it.

note.description: Required when `repeat` is "differed": say what differed between the two fetches
